summaries.en: Chronos-2 is a foundation model for time series forecasting that transforms raw time series data into token sequences for unified prediction across domains. It leverages a T5-based encoder-decoder architecture pretrained on diverse datasets, enabling zero-shot forecasting without domain-specific training. Users can fine-tune it on custom time series data or apply it directly for tasks like sales prediction, energy load forecasting, or anomaly detection, making advanced forecasting accessible with minimal setup.
summaries.zh: Chronos-2 是一个时间序列预测基础模型，它将原始时序数据转换为标记序列，实现跨领域的统一预测。该模型基于 T5 编码器-解码器架构，在多样化数据集上预训练，无需领域特定训练即可进行零样本预测。用户可将其直接用于销售预测、能源负荷分析或异常检测等场景，也可在自定义数据上微调，让复杂的时间序列分析变得简单易用，适合快速实验和实际部署。
